📦 **sirius-menu-art `2c376f9`** — art: add eight restaurant and tavern menu icons

Generate four plated meals, hot chocolate, wine, grog drink and song/story activity in cocoa pixel style. ArtGallery02dcecd exhibited masters and128px/32px previews first. Import eight transparent PNGs and bind non-food menuIcon metadata; preserve older grog-with-meat concept. No economic recipe fields changed.

Expand dish accounting to9 service menu icons and require full restaurant/tavern coverage.17 dish images validated; missing fish/wine negative controls detected and restored. Actual townBld menus and tbiUI/CSS browser previews confirm food, drink and activity icons; existing service/site regressions pass. Full WebGL town not exercised.

Refs TASK-1002

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
